name: closes nested frames innermost first and supports repeated frame names
input: a recursive stack changes beneath its first frame
test:
events = stack_samples_to_trace_events([(0, ['serve', 'serve', 'decode']), (2, ['serve', 'encode'])], 4)
assert events == [
    {'name': 'serve', 'phase': 'B', 'timestamp': 0},
    {'name': 'serve', 'phase': 'B', 'timestamp': 0},
    {'name': 'decode', 'phase': 'B', 'timestamp': 0},
    {'name': 'decode', 'phase': 'E', 'timestamp': 2},
    {'name': 'serve', 'phase': 'E', 'timestamp': 2},
    {'name': 'encode', 'phase': 'B', 'timestamp': 2},
    {'name': 'encode', 'phase': 'E', 'timestamp': 4},
    {'name': 'serve', 'phase': 'E', 'timestamp': 4},
]
assert stack_samples_to_trace_events([], 3) == []
